_notes: Address: Student app and student-facing mobile strings use informal 'je/jij/jou' throughout (matching the existing nl student.json); staff-facing mobile:agency.*, mobile:university.*, mobile:v3.agency.*, mobile:v3.uni.*, mobile:v3.reviews.*, mobile:v3.deadlines.*, mobile:v3.tasks.*, mobile:v4.uni.*, mobile:v26.uni.* use formal 'u', per the brief. NOTE the existing nl agency.json/university.json consoles mostly use 'je' (16 hits vs 1-2 'u'); owner should decide whether the consoles move to 'u' or the native staff apps stay 'je'.

Shared mobile-ui strings (mobile:messages.*, mobile:settings.*, mobile:login.*, mobile:notifications.*, mobile:v29.mfa.*) are rendered in all three native apps, so they are written pronoun-free ('het team', 'de verbinding') to fit both registers.
plan → 'pakket' (existing convention in every nl namespace; 'plan' in Dutch reads as a scheme). Two stray 'plan'/'ondersteuningsplan' occurrences were aligned.

application → 'aanmelding' (never 'aanvraag', which is reserved for visa and dormitory applications: 'visumaanvraag'). sign in → 'inloggen', sign up → 'registreren'/'account aanmaken', matching common.json.

matches (student-app rendering of university recommendation) → 'matches' is kept, as the English keeps it; plan/allowance copy uses 'Universiteitsaanbevelingen' / 'Aanbevolen universiteiten' per the glossary.

consultation → 'adviesgesprek'; 'Diagnostic consultation' rendered as 'Intakegesprek' (the natural Dutch term for a first assessment conversation; 'Diagnosegesprek' and 'consult' read as medical). Owner may prefer another word.

personal statement → 'motivatiebrief' (the established Dutch admissions term; 'persoonlijke verklaring' is unnatural); study plan → 'studieplan'; document review → 'documentcontrole' (student) / 'controle' (agency review queue); 'verifiëren' kept only for the official verify action.

Hangyul team → 'het Hangyul-team'; Hangyul Univ team → 'het Hangyul Univ-team', mirrored key by key from the English. Four mobile strings said 'je adviseur' where the English says the Hangyul team; changed, since the student may not have a single counselor.
Official names kept: GKS, D-2/D-4, apostille, 'consulaire legalisatie', 'standaard toelatingsbrief' (where the English says standard admission letter), TOPIK/IELTS/TOEFL iBT, Toss Payments.
dormitory → 'studentenhuisvesting (van de universiteit)'; housing (topic) → 'huisvesting'; arrival and settling-in help → 'hulp bij aankomst en de eerste weken' ('settelen' is colloquial).
mock interview → 'oefeninterview' (one term; 'oefengesprek' collided with consultation vocabulary). managed application → 'begeleide aanmelding'.
Due (Hangyul task) → 'Uiterlijk {{date}}'; Closes/Deadline (university) → 'Sluit op'/'Deadline'. Overdue → 'te laat'.

Back-check: no promise added. 'Hangyul regelt {{what}}' (gate) and 'Beschikbaar na' (visa) were softened back to what the English says; 'Te laat' flags and 'toegezegde reactietijd' render the SLA 'promise' without promising the student anything.
Plurals: every _one form carries {{count}} or reads correctly without it; 'uur' is invariant in Dutch after a number ('Wacht 3 uur'), so _one and _other both read correctly.

mobile:v4.home.item.RENEW.title uses 'nieuw(e) {{label}}' because the adjective ending depends on the gender of the inserted document name; a gender-neutral alternative would need a different sentence shape (owner's call).
